correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed scalar y=1/b affine contractive Poincare map; its periodic fixed point yields exact m(T)=A-2(H-L)atanh(epsilon*tanh(T/4))/T. Directly differentiating g(z)=atanh(epsilon*tanh z) shows g(0)=0 and g''<0 for z>0, so m strictly increases B<m<A. Triangular Floquet Jacobian gives rho_a=exp(lambda T(m-1)), rho_b=exp(-T). Scalar logistic comparison b<=z and exponential convergence of inverse logistic profiles bound a(t)<=C exp(lambda(m-1)t); stable inverse b equation then gives b-b_T->0. Independent scalar numeric root for H=2,L=1/2 is 7.901747381549. Universal argument is analytic, not 60 quadrature samples.
